label: D0_factor3_pure_analyst_uncertainty_value_POOL_ORTHOGONAL
purpose: 3rd D0 factor, LOW correlation with the ENTIRE existing alpha pool (19 alphas: IV + price/volume technicals)
economic_thesis: analyst forecast DISPERSION + predicted UNCERTAINTY + light VALUE — fundamental signal orthogonal to the pool's IV & price/volume technicals
expression: group_zscore(add(add(group_zscore(ts_backfill(divide(subtract(vec_avg(anl4_basicconqf_high), vec_avg(anl4_basicconqf_low)), vec_avg(anl4_basicconqf_mean)), 66), industry), multiply(0.5,group_zscore(ts_backfill(vec_avg(anl4_basicconqf_pu), 66), industry))), multiply(0.2,group_zscore(ts_backfill(divide(bookvalue_ps, close), 66), industry))), industry)
pool_corr_note: max corr 0.262 vs the whole 19-alpha pool (lowest among all high-SH candidates); pure dispersion is even lower at 0.226 (SH 1.01)
key_constraint: At D0 without IV, ANY SH>2.0 factor needs short interest, which inherently correlates ~0.42 with the pool's IV/price-volume alphas. So submittable (SH>2.0) and pool-uncorrelated (<0.3) are mutually exclusive at D0 non-IV. This factor maximizes Sharpe (1.54) subject to genuine pool-orthogonality (0.262).
